title: Compliance milestone tracking runbook for SOC2/ISO and SSO rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Create a single, enforceable milestone tracking runbook that coordinates SOC2 readiness, ISO27001 gap closure, SSO/SAML integration, and audit log evidence collection. This ticket centralizes milestone definitions, owners, acceptance criteria, and gating checks so PM/Eng/Design/legal can reason about compliance readiness across Dedicated and Private deployments.

Scope: Milestone definitions and checkpoints for: 1) SOC2 readiness (control mapping, evidence collection, test plan), 2) ISO27001 gap remediation (risk register, policy updates), 3) SSO/SAML (IdP integration, SAML assertions, SCIM user provisioning), 4) Audit logs (collection, retention policy, tamper-evidence), and 5) Release gating for Private deployments (upgrade checklist and rollback path).

Deliverables:
- Master milestone list with owner, due date, and acceptance criteria for each control area.
- A one-page runbook artifact for go/no-go gating used by PM/Legal/Eng.
- Linked evidence trackers (Google Sheet / Confluence) and PR templates for required artifacts (confidential evidence referenced).
- Small set of follow-up eng tickets for automation (log forwarding, retention enforcement, SSO test harness).

Acceptance criteria (high level):
- Each major control area has at least one named owner and an explicit artifact path (Confluence/Drive/GitHub).
- A rolling evidence queue exists and is accessible to auditors and internal reviewers.
- SSO test plan validates provisioning, login, and SAML attribute assertions across Redwood Private and Dedicated setups.
- Audit logs are forwarded to the centralized SIEM in staging and have a documented retention policy matching SOC2/ISO requirements.

Stakeholders: PM (Aisha Patel), Security Lead (Maya Chen), Infra/Eng owners (Diego Morales, Samir Kapoor), Design (Lila Nguyen), Legal/Compliance (Robert King). Review cadence: weekly sync + biweekly milestone demo for execs.

Notes / Constraints: Evidence contains customer data for some proofs — coordinate with Legal and Support to scrub or use synthetic data. Some infra automation depends on ENG-4129 (log pipeline hardening) and ENG-4184 (SAML metadata rotation service).
